subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue stay open as the umbrella for Control UI reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of the narrower reply-metadata PR and durable final-fallback issue?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback delivery contract are accepted or replaced.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply-metadata PR or issue and the final-fallback issue fully own the two halves.

options.title: Narrow To Quote UI
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as enough for Control UI replies, which would intentionally drop the structured metadata ask.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback delivery contract are accepted or replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest observed history across reply prompt envelopes, webchat runtime context, and agent runtime internals among the routed owners.
